mainEntity.name: Is outsourced bookkeeping cheaper than hiring in-house?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most small businesses, yes — you skip payroll taxes, benefits, software, and training, and you typically get someone more experienced.

mainEntity.name: Will I lose control of my books if I outsource?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. With shared QuickBooks access you see the same live data I do, anytime.

mainEntity.name: What does outsourced bookkeeping actually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually a monthly close: reconciliations, categorization, financial statements, and a review of what the numbers mean.

mainEntity.name: Do we have to meet in person?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The work is virtual and secure — shared file access and document sharing replace in-person handoffs.
